ios.desc:
Dev Notes++ is your all-in-one companion for tracking app development. Log bugs, features, and ideas. Plan promotions. Manage App Store screenshots. Take rich text notes. See your progress on a Dashboard — all synced across your devices with iCloud.

Track Everything
Create apps and organize bugs, features, and ideas by version. Mark items as open, in progress, or done. Filter by status, type, and version — filters sync across devices. Quick-add by type with a long press on +.

Share from Anywhere
Use the system share sheet to send text, links, or images directly into Dev Notes++. Save as a Bug, Feature, Idea, Post, or Notes. URLs show a rich preview card. Share multiple images at once. Your last-used app is remembered.

App Store Info
Paste a Bundle ID or App Store URL to auto-import your app's icon, description, rating, in-app purchases, genres, and more from any App Store region.

Dashboard
See your completion rate, bug trends, 7-day activity, and stats at a glance. Filter by date range. Show or hide apps from your stats. Tap any stat card to drill down.

Promote
Draft social media posts with character counts for X, Threads, Bluesky, and more. Track post status from draft to published. Duplicate posts for quick variations.

Screenshots
Organize App Store screenshots across 65 locales. Drag to reorder. Tap to edit or view full screen.

Rich Notes
Write formatted notes with bold, italic, lists, and inline images.

Backup & Restore
Create full backups. Restore selectively — pick exactly which apps and items to import.

Export
Export to JSON & Markdown, PDF report, or CSV spreadsheet.

Sync
iCloud sync across all your devices. Settings, filters, and data stay in sync automatically.

Free to Start
Track up to 2 apps for free. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited apps, screenshots, export, global search, and more.
